ValidationRule.description: Prevents edits to PHOCS Contacts associated with Business Entity or Facility Accounts unless the user has the PHOCS Officer or PHOCS Admin permission.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), $RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSContact", OR( Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = "Business_Entity", Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = "Facility" ), OR( $Permission.PHOCSOfficer, $Permission.PHOCSAdmin ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Officers cannot edit this Contact record.
